scripts.generate:models: pnpm --dir packages/identity/model run build && pnpm --dir packages/resources/model run build
scripts.generate:contexts: pnpm --dir packages/identity/server run compose && pnpm --dir packages/identity/server run handlers && pnpm --dir packages/resources/server run compose && pnpm --dir packages/resources/server run handlers
scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:models && pnpm run generate:contexts && pnpm run generate:app
scripts.test: pnpm -r run build && ACCESS_DESK_TEST_STORAGE=memory vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:postgresql: pnpm -r run build && ACCESS_DESK_TEST_STORAGE=postgresql vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.verify: pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm -r run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.postgres:start: docker compose --env-file .env --file deploy/compose.yaml up --detach --wait postgres && docker compose --env-file .env --file deploy/compose.yaml exec postgres /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-databases.sh
